_comment: Non-secret config for automation/send.mjs (see automation/SEND.md). The Brevo API key is NOT here — it comes from the BREVO_API_KEY env var / GitHub Actions secret and must never be committed. After you create the account: (1) authenticate jparkassociates.com and set sender/replyTo to a real address on that domain; (2) create one Brevo list per active segment and paste each numeric list id below.
